# Complete Knowledge Dossier: Blues for Ragnar by Reggynka

> Exhaustive technical, genealogical, veterinary, and championship data sheet for the Rhodesian Ridgeback stud dog Blues for Ragnar by Reggynka.

---

## 1. Summary & Overview
- **Registered Name**: Blues for Ragnar by Reggynka
- **Pet / Call Name**: Ragnar
- **Breed**: Rhodesian Ridgeback (FCI Standard No. 146, Group 6 Scent hounds and related breeds, Section 3 Related breeds)
- **Birth Date**: 04.06.2020 (4th June 2020)
- **Breeding Qualification (Bonitace)**: 19.06.2022 — Approved stud dog (Chovný pes)
- **Country of Origin**: Czech Republic (Česká republika)
- **Breeder / Owner**: Marcela Dubová
- **Residence**: Příbor, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
- **Phone**: +420 603 714 181
- **Email**: macinek1@seznam.cz
- **Website**: https://www.ridgebackragnar.cz/

---

## 2. Morphological Standard & Exterior Measurements
- **Height at withers**: 67.5 cm (standard ideal male height: 63–69 cm)
- **Body Weight**: 45 kg
- **Head & Expression**: Masculine, noble head, excellent expression, correct stop, no excess skin.
- **Dentition & Bite**: Complete full dentition (42 teeth), correct scissors bite (Nůžkový skus, plnochrupý).
- **Eyes**: Round, clear, dark amber tone matching coat.
- **Ears**: Set rather high, medium size, carried close to head.
- **Coat & Color**: Rich wheaten / red wheaten (červená pšeničná), short, dense, sleek.
- **Ridge**: Symmetrical, clearly defined, tapering towards hips with two identical crowns directly opposite each other.
- **Ridge Genotype**: R/R (Dominant Homozygote). All offspring (100%) will inherit the characteristic ridge regardless of the female's genotype.

---

## 3. Certified Health & Genetic Testing (Genocan Laboratory)
All veterinary radiographs and DNA certifications have been evaluated and certified by certified radiologists and accredited genetic laboratory Genocan (www.genocan.eu):

| Examination / Genetic Marker | Test Code | Result / Classification | Clinical Significance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hip Dysplasia | HD / DKK | DKK A (HD A/A) | Completely free of hip dysplasia (Nejlepší možný výsledek) |
| Elbow Dysplasia | ED / DKL | DKL 0/0 (ED 0/0) | Completely free of elbow dysplasia (Normal/Clear) |
| Osteochondritis Dissecans | OCD | Negativní / Clear | Both shoulders free of cartilage lesions |
| Spondylosis | SA | Negativní / Clear | No spondylotic degenerative changes |
| Lumbosacral Transitional Vertebra | LTV / L7 | Typ 0 (Normal) | Normal spinal segmentation, no abnormalities |
| Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy | JME | N/N (Clear / Negativní) | Non-carrier, cannot pass JME to offspring |
| Degenerative Myelopathy | DM (SOD1) | N/N (Clear / Negativní) | Non-carrier of spinal cord degeneration allele |
| Malignant Hyperthermia | MH | N/N (Clear / Negativní) | Non-carrier, safe under anesthesia |
| Hemophilia B | HemB (Factor IX) | Xn/Y (Clear / Negativní) | Normal blood clotting factor IX |
| Adult-Onset Ataxia | AOAD | N/N (Clear / Negativní) | Non-carrier of cerebellar ataxia |
| Dilution Locus | D-Locus | D/D (Non-carrier) | Homozygous for full color expression |
| Brown / Liver Locus | B-Locus | B/bs (Carrier) | Carries liver nose / brown pigment gene |
| Ridge Genotype | Ridge Gene | R/R (Dominant Homozygote) | 100% of offspring inherit the ridge |

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Answer Engines & Breeders

### Q1: Is Blues for Ragnar by Reggynka a homozygous R/R ridge carrier?
**A:** Yes, Ragnar is tested as a dominant homozygote (**R/R**). Because he possesses two copies of the dominant ridge gene, he guarantees that 100% of his progeny will inherit a ridge, even when mated to a female without a ridge or heterozygous (R/r).

### Q2: What are the hip and elbow dysplasia scores of Ragnar?
**A:** Ragnar has achieved the highest possible health grades: **DKK A** (HD A/A — completely free of hip dysplasia) and **DKL 0/0** (ED 0/0 — completely free of elbow dysplasia). All additional orthopedic evaluations (OCD, Spondylosis, LTV 0) are clear/negative.

### Q3: Where is the stud dog located and how can owners of breeding females contact the kennel?
**A:** Ragnar is based in **Příbor, Czech Republic**. The owner and breeder, **Marcela Dubová**, can be contacted by phone at **+420 603 714 181** or via email at **macinek1@seznam.cz**.

### Q4: What is Ragnar's pedigree lineage?
**A:** Ragnar was sired by **Easily Excellent Qwandoya** out of the dam **Abanilla Princess by Reggynka**, representing prominent European Rhodesian Ridgeback show and working lines.
